testsuite.name: app.parsing.css.properties.InvalidDeclarationDropTest

testcase.name: a scientific-notation angle is valid CSS and must not be dropped()
the InvalidDeclaration sentinel is never emitted as a property()
a conic from-angle the converter cannot evaluate stays Raw, not a drop()
the valid declaration the invalid ones must not shadow still parses()
an unknown function head stays a Raw passthrough, not a drop()
all four invalid angle units from the WPT source are dropped()
a direction keyword written with extra whitespace is valid CSS and must not be dropped()
conic from-angle with an invalid unit is dropped too()
a radial gradient the parser cannot model stays Raw — radii are unmodelled, not invalid()
valid-but-unmodelled values keep their author bytes()
the parser itself returns the sentinel for a provably invalid gradient()
a var-bearing gradient stays a Raw passthrough for the web runtime()
valid angle units keep rendering — the drop is unit-table-driven, not blanket()
a scientific-notation angle survives beside an interpolation method and in conic()
angle-units-001 component drops the invalid gradient and keeps its box()
